name: okr-doing-agent
description: Install a local OKR Doing system, inventory old OKR assets, and guide migration safely.

interface.shortDescription: Install OKR OS, inventory old assets, and guide migration.
interface.longDescription: OKR Doing Agent provides three workflows: OKR 系统安装 for previewing and installing a lightweight ten-year Logseq OKR system, OKR 资产盘点 for read-only old asset inventory, and OKR 资产迁移 for guided migration/fusion from inventory into the new system with preview and explicit confirmation.
interface.defaultPrompt: 用 OKR Doing Agent 帮我做 OKR 系统安装、OKR 资产盘点，或 OKR 资产迁移。
